summary: AstroNova filed an 8-K reporting a settlement agreement resolving claims from its May 2024 MTEX acquisition. The settlement involves transfer of a Portuguese industrial property valued at €2.5 million and release of personal guarantees. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is present. This is a post-acquisition dispute resolution, not a new special situation transaction. The filing is a routine current report on a material definitive agreement, not a corporate event like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. What to watch: registration of the property in Portugal and termination of arbitration.
